name: Silk Comforter
description: Mulberry silk fill with a naturally protein-rich structure that regulates temperature in all seasons. Lightweight, hypoallergenic, and breathable — the preferred choice for sensitive skin.
description_zh: 桑蠶絲填充，天然蛋白質結構四季調溫。輕盈、低敏、透氣——敏感肌膚的首選棉被。

name: Wool Comforter
description: Natural wool fill with an exceptional warmth-to-weight ratio. Naturally anti-static and moisture-regulating — ideal for cold sleepers who want substantial coverage without overheating.
description_zh: 天然羊毛填充，保暖性與重量比卓越。天然防靜電、調節濕氣——適合怕冷且想要厚實包覆感而不悶熱的睡眠者。

name: Down Comforter
description: Premium white down clusters deliver outstanding warmth with remarkable lightness. High fill power creates a cloud-like loft — perfect for cold sleepers who prefer the enveloping feel of a fluffy duvet.
description_zh: 頂級白鵝絨提供卓越保暖性與驚人輕盈感。高蓬鬆度打造如雲朵般的被體——適合喜愛蓬鬆包覆感的怕冷者。

name: TN Tech Fiber Comforter
description: High-performance technical fiber fill that bounces back wash after wash. Machine washable, hypoallergenic, and available in summer, all-season, and winter weights — the practical choice for busy households.
description_zh: 高性能科技纖維填充，每次洗滌後依然回彈蓬鬆。可機洗、低敏，夏季、四季及冬季重量均有提供——忙碌家庭的實用首選。
